title: Frontend Engineering Intern
description: Build and improve product interfaces using React, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, and modern frontend practices. You will work closely with designers and backend engineers to implement responsive features, consume REST APIs, fix UI issues, and improve the overall user experience. Applicants should have practical experience with JavaScript and React through coursework, personal projects, or previous internships.

title: Backend Engineering Intern
description: Work with the engineering team to develop backend services, APIs, and database integrations. The role involves writing server-side JavaScript, designing API endpoints, handling data validation, debugging application issues, and learning how production web applications are structured. Experience with Node.js, Express, SQL or NoSQL databases, and Git is preferred.

title: UI/UX Design Intern
description: Help design interfaces for web and mobile products from early concepts through polished prototypes. You will create wireframes, user flows, visual designs, and interactive prototypes while collaborating with developers and product managers. Applicants should be comfortable with Figma and have a portfolio demonstrating coursework, personal projects, or previous design work.

title: Cloud Engineering Intern
description: Assist with cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and containerized applications. You will learn how applications are deployed and maintained in cloud environments and help engineers automate repetitive infrastructure tasks. Familiarity with Linux, Docker, networking, or AWS/Azure/GCP is useful but not mandatory.

title: Data Engineering Intern
description: Support the data platform team in cleaning, transforming, and moving data between internal systems. Interns will work with Python, SQL, data pipelines, and cloud-based data services. Coursework or projects involving databases, data structures, Python, or data analytics are strongly relevant.

title: DevOps Intern
description: Join the infrastructure team and learn how modern applications are built, tested, deployed, and monitored. The intern will assist with CI/CD pipelines, Docker containers, cloud infrastructure, and deployment automation. Basic knowledge of Linux, Git, scripting, and cloud concepts is expected.

title: Finance & Business Analytics Intern
description: Assist the finance and strategy team with financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, and business performance tracking. The intern will prepare spreadsheets, analyze trends, support budgeting exercises, and help turn financial data into useful recommendations. Applicants should be comfortable with Excel and basic quantitative analysis.

title: Product Management Intern
description: Work alongside product managers to understand customer problems, define product requirements, analyze user feedback, and support feature planning. This role is suitable for students studying business, information systems, computer science, or related disciplines who enjoy working between technical and business teams.

title: Digital Marketing Intern
description: Help develop and execute digital marketing campaigns across social media, email, search, and content channels. You will assist with campaign planning, content creation, performance reporting, competitor research, and audience analysis. Students studying marketing, communications, business, or related fields are encouraged to apply.

title: Sustainability Data Intern
description: Help the sustainability team collect, clean, and analyze environmental and operational data. The role involves spreadsheet analysis, visualization, reporting, and researching sustainability metrics. Students in environmental studies, data science, engineering, business, or related fields can apply.

title: Sustainability Communications Intern
description: Support communications around sustainability projects by researching topics, writing articles, preparing presentations, and helping communicate environmental initiatives to customers and partners. Strong writing, research, and presentation skills are more important than previous sustainability experience.

title: Operations Intern
description: Support day-to-day operations by documenting processes, analyzing operational data, coordinating tasks, and identifying opportunities for efficiency improvements. This role is suited to students studying business administration, operations management, information systems, or related subjects.

title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Help develop learning tools and web features for an education platform. The intern will work on frontend components, APIs, testing, and bug fixes. Experience with JavaScript, React, Python, or web development coursework is useful.

title: Educational Content Intern
description: Create and organize educational content for university students. You will research topics, write explanations, review existing learning material, and collaborate with product and academic teams. Strong writing and research skills are required, while experience with education or content platforms is a plus.

title: Growth Marketing Intern
description: Assist the growth team with user acquisition campaigns, social media experiments, email campaigns, landing pages, and performance analysis. You will work with marketing and product teams to identify opportunities to increase user engagement. Students in marketing, business, communications, or analytics are encouraged to apply.

title: Content Strategy Intern
description: Research audiences and competitors, develop content ideas, assist with editorial calendars, and measure content performance. The ideal candidate enjoys writing, storytelling, social media, and understanding why certain content performs better than others.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst Intern
description: Assist security analysts with monitoring alerts, documenting incidents, reviewing security logs, and researching common vulnerabilities. Students studying cybersecurity, information security, computer science, or networking are encouraged to apply. Familiarity with Linux, networking, authentication, or security fundamentals is preferred.

title: Security Research Intern
description: Research emerging cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and defensive practices. The intern will help produce internal security reports and assist with controlled security testing. Coursework in cybersecurity, networking, operating systems, or digital forensics is highly relevant.

title: Construction Project Management Intern
description: Support project managers with schedules, documentation, procurement tracking, progress reporting, and coordination between project stakeholders. Students studying construction management, civil engineering, business, or project management are encouraged to apply.

title: Recruitment Operations Intern
description: Support the recruitment team by organizing candidate information, coordinating interviews, preparing reports, and improving internal hiring processes. The role is suitable for students studying human resources, business administration, psychology, management, or related fields.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Work with analysts to clean datasets, build dashboards, investigate trends, and communicate insights to internal teams. Applicants should have coursework or project experience in statistics, data science, business analytics, computer science, or a related discipline. Python, SQL, Excel, and visualization experience are useful.

title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Assist the data science team with data preprocessing, exploratory analysis, model development, and evaluation. Interns will experiment with machine learning approaches and document results. Applicants should have a foundation in Python, statistics, and machine learning through coursework or projects.

title: Business Intelligence Intern
description: Help transform business data into dashboards and reports used for decision-making. The intern will work with spreadsheets, SQL queries, visualization tools, and business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and communicate findings.

title: Research & Insights Intern
description: Support research projects by collecting information, analyzing market trends, preparing reports, and turning qualitative and quantitative findings into useful recommendations. Students studying business, economics, statistics, data science, or social sciences are encouraged to apply.
